messages.body: Move the status page to the new host tonight?

decision.question: Move the status page to the new host tonight?
decision.why: The old host’s certificate expires in two days.

options.label: Yes, DNS change approved
options.what_happens: status-page switches traffic to the new host and watches it for 30 minutes.

options.label: Not tonight
options.what_happens: The old host stays live; status-page asks again tomorrow morning.

messages.hands_on: Approve the DNS change at the domain registrar. It asks for your two-factor code, so a ship cannot do it.
